Each partition maps to a scalar value in [0,1], where failure in any leads to 'blocked'. Only when all are satisfied does the system reach 'ready_for_disposable_rehearsal_review', which remains non-executive. The structure enforces a layered safety protocol through dualism of verification (local tests) and authorization (owner sign-off), preventing premature production deployment. Failure modes include incomplete shadow evidence (E_s < 1), boundary violations (B_r < 1), and missing approvals (A_o = 0). These form a conjunction-based logic where readiness status is determined by the minimum of these values across all gates.
